title: Walsh coordinates and Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set, let $f:\{\pm1\}^{\iota}\to\mathbb R$, and let $T\subseteq\iota$. The $T$-coordinate of $f$ in the Walsh basis is its Fourier coefficient $\mathbb E_x[f(x)\prod_{i\in T}x_i]$, where the expectation is uniform over all sign assignments.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on sign assignments
